title: Purchase Protection
description: Covers eligible purchases against accidental damage or theft for a limited period after purchase.

title: Extended Warranty
description: Extends the manufacturer's warranty on eligible electronics purchases by up to 2 additional years.

title: Return Protection
description: Reimburses eligible items that a merchant refuses to accept for return within 90 days of purchase.

title: Travel Delay Insurance
description: Reimburses reasonable expenses (meals, lodging) when a covered trip is delayed beyond a set threshold.

title: Mobile Phone Protection
description: Covers damage or theft of a mobile phone when the monthly bill is paid with an eligible card.

title: Rental Car Protection
description: Provides collision damage waiver coverage when a rental car is booked entirely with an eligible card.

title: Baggage Loss Coverage
description: Reimburses the value of checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged, or stolen during a covered trip.

title: Price Drop Protection
description: Refunds the price difference if an eligible item's price drops within 60 days of purchase.
